reading: Air travel may face more disruption as climate change brings more severe weather.
During a busy summer travel period, storms near London caused long delays.
Air traffic teams guided aircraft around the storms, reducing the space available for other flights.
Some departures had to wait on the ground because the skies were congested.
Some planes might need to change their routes.
When aircraft land at a different airport, there must be space and facilities for the extra arrivals.
Pilots use radar and forecasts to help them avoid dangerous weather.
However, fast-moving storms can force changes late in a flight.
